messages.content: Write the copy for the pricing page of a code review tool, covering three tiers. Around 250 words.

output:
**Pricing**

Every plan reviews every pull request. What changes between them is how much history you keep, and how many people you're keeping it for.

**Solo — Free**
One private repo, unlimited public ones. Comments land inline about 90 seconds after you push. You get the same rule engine the paid tiers run; what you don't get is the dashboard, and if you're one person you don't need it. No card.

**Team — $18 per active contributor / month**
"Active" means someone who opened a PR that month. Nobody else counts, so the bill tracks the work instead of the seat list. Unlimited repos. Custom rules in YAML, shared across the org. Twelve months of history, enough to tell whether that flaky module is actually getting better or you just stopped looking at it. Slack and Linear hooks. SSO through Google or Okta.

**Self-hosted — from $2,400/year**
Runs in your VPC. Nothing leaves the network: no source, no diffs, no telemetry. Ships with a Terraform module and an air-gapped install path. A named engineer sits in a shared channel with your team and usually answers the same day. Priced by repo count rather than headcount — we'll quote you on a 20-minute call.

Annual billing takes 20% off Team. Downgrading is one click and we refund the unused months. And if a review ever flags something that isn't a problem, tell us. We fix the rule and ship it to everyone.

---

Prices, limits, and integrations are invented placeholders — swap in your real numbers before this goes live.
